The Carte Blanche Christmas Special 2020

By: Sinethemba Nogude | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Its the most wonderful time of the year,Join Carte Blanche as we usher in the festive season.

Unique Selling Point:
Featuring Belinda David's who made the whole nation proud as she showcased her spectacular voice on Britain's Got Talent by channeling her inner Whitney Houston- catapulting her to an international sensation.

This year's Carte Blanche Christmas show promises to be one to remember- as Belinda will be serenading us into the festive season.

DEREK:
Good evening and welcome to this very special broadcast of Carte Blanche, on the roof of the City of Gold, and in celebration of so much good news in our world.


On our show tonight:

● The Carte Blanche Making a Difference Trust and its professional partners race against the lockdown clock to build an Intensive Care Unit for babies at Tygerberg Hospital.


● While a pandemic has raged...our other great challenge, climate change - enjoyed a reprieve. And now there’s good news from research on the Indian Ocean, off Africa.


● Some beautiful fruit has grown from the dark soil of lockdown and food scarcity - a food garden movement reaching across rich and poor suburbs in Cape Town.


● Finally, with high-tech precision, law enforcement, private security and Transnet take the fight to criminals who are pilfering thousands of litres of fuel from bulk pipelines.



DEREK: CAM
We look forward to reading your tweets using #CarteBlanche and your comments on our Facebook page.




DEREK: CAM
But first. The voice and message of Belinda Davids - critically-acclaimed vocalist who enthralled a global audience this year. She describes herself as an entertainer, world traveller and all-round fierce South African woman. Apart from her long-running show called The Greatest Love...the world really got to know the Port Elizabeth-born artist for her jaw-dropping performance at Britain’s Got Talent. She has an astonishing four-octave range and while she’s never had formal vocal training, she has had a 3-decade career that’s taken her around the world. Belinda Davids.

So much talent in our country - we’d love to hear your thoughts on our social pages.

While COVID-19 put pressure on hospitals, the Carte Blanche Making a Difference Trust together with a dedicated team of experts in hospital construction, was waiting and preparing to build a new dedicated two-bed intensive care unit for pre and post-operative care of newborns and children at Tygerberg Hospital in Cape Town. The easing of lockdown allowed the team to kick into action - and now they’re racing around the clock to get the unit built - in case lockdown levels are escalated again.

That’s it for our show tonight.

We would like to wish you a blessed Christmas and urge you to stay safe, wear your mask and social distance as you celebrate this special season.
If you’ve missed one of our stories you can watch the show again at 8pm on M-Net Plus one channel 901 and of course on Catch Up.
As always, stay safe and from me and the Carte Blanche team - have a magic week and cheers for now.
